description: Defines the immutable class BaseClientData which encapsulates connection-related data for BaseClientActor, including connection ID, connection object, connection statuses, session senders, and related methods.

classes.name: BaseClientData
classes.description: Immutable class holding connection state data for BaseClientActor, including connection ID, connection object, statuses, session senders, and methods to update and manage this data.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the connection.

methods.name: getConnectionStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns optional details about the connection status.

methods.name: getInConnectionStatusSince
methods.description: Returns the timestamp since when the connection has been in its current status.

methods.name: getSessionSenders
methods.description: Returns the list of session sender pairs (ActorRef and DittoHeaders).

methods.name: setConnection
methods.description: Returns a new BaseClientData instance with updated connection.

methods.name: setConnectionStatus
methods.description: Returns a new BaseClientData instance with updated connection status.

methods.name: setDesiredConnectionStatus
methods.description: Returns a new BaseClientData instance with updated desired connection status.

methods.name: setConnectionStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns a new BaseClientData instance with updated connection status details.

methods.name: addSessionSender
methods.description: Adds a session sender ActorRef with DittoHeaders, returning a new instance.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets session senders to empty, indicating a stable state.
